facts.heading: The post-war boom
facts.body: Vaccines, mechanised farming and falling infant mortality push populations up across the world.

facts.heading: Five billion approaching
facts.body: Asia drives most of the growth while Europe slows sharply.

facts.heading: A decade of shifts
facts.body: The Soviet Union dissolves; Eastern European populations start to decline.

facts.heading: Eight billion
facts.body: The world passes eight billion people; India overtakes China as the largest population.
